ops.text: ccx vcs ship took the Graphite lane in cc-skills (yasyf-owned, direct-push-to-main flow) because a stray .git/.graphite_repo_config is present; gt submit then failed with "Graphite could not verify you have access to yasyf/cc-skills". jj is installed but the repo has no live jj workspace, so the documented jj lane doesn't engage either. Recovery was manual: ff main to the gt-created commit, fetch/rebase, plain git push, delete the gt branch. Either the graphite config should be removed or ship's lane detection needs an owned-repo override.
